obligations.engine_must: emit one commit-intent-v1 per durable project-state write, accept every ack in `accept`, refuse every ack in `refuse_on_bytes` by its named commit-ack-v1 code, refuse every ack in `refuse_on_lineage` by its named anchor-contract code, and invoke no durability tool of its own
obligations.anchor_must: acknowledge every intent in `acknowledge` with a commit-ack-v1 carrying that intent's exact sha256

c7b.note: The engine half is closed and green in this repository. The half that honours an intent ships from the Anchor repository; until it does, every durability surface reports an unacknowledged receipt as 'state not yet committed'.
